title: Design a NOT Gate
description: Design a NOT gate (inverter) that takes a single input and produces its complement as output. The NOT gate is one of the fundamental building blocks in digital electronics.

examples.explanation: When input is 0, NOT gate outputs 1
When input is 1, NOT gate outputs 0

explanation: The NOT gate is implemented using the bitwise NOT operator (~) in Verilog. This is a simple combinational logic circuit that inverts the input signal. The assign statement creates a continuous assignment, meaning the output automatically updates whenever the input changes.
hints: Use the logical NOT operator (~) in Verilog
Remember that assign statements are for continuous assignment in combinational logic
The output should always be the opposite of the input
